description: Reorganize your stock watchlists. Create a new watchlist named 'Core Holdings'. Move Apple (AAPL) and Microsoft (MSFT) from the default 'My Watchlist' to this new 'Core Holdings' watchlist. Finally, remove AAPL and MSFT from 'My Watchlist', leaving only GOOGL, AMZN, and NVDA there. The final state should have two watchlists: 'Core Holdings' with AAPL and MSFT, and 'My Watchlist' with the remaining three stocks.
